ACTIONSWARM | 2026-10-26 | Nimbus Labs x Meridian Bank kickoff | Summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs kicked off the pilot for the Nimbus Ledger Sync project, aiming to automate UPI reconciliation by November 30. The meeting established scope limits, security details, and a clear timeline for sandbox access, sample data, and mapping documents. | Decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.; Phase one is limited to UPI reconciliation only, excluding NEFT and IMPS.; Primary hosting will be AWS Mumbai with a disaster recovery replica in Singapore. | Tasks: I will send you our standard mutual NDA. (Riya Sharma, 2026-11-04); I will set up the sandbox environment and send API credentials to Vikram's team by Friday 6 November. (Karan, 2026-11-06); I will send those by Tuesday 10 November. (unassigned, 2026-11-10); I will write a mapping document that says which Meridian field feeds which Nimbus field. I can have that to you by Monday 16 November. (Riya Sharma, 2026-11-16); I will send you their names by Friday 13 November. (unassigned, 2026-11-13); Arjun, our intern, is not here today, but he will prepare anonymised sample transaction files from the layout you gave us. Let's say by Thursday 12 November. (Arjun, 2026-11-12); And the NDA will be with Neha by Wednesday 4 November. (Riya Sharma, 2026-11-04)

ACTIONSWARM | 2026-10-31 | Nimbus Labs x Meridian Bank kickoff | Summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs agreed to launch a pilot of the Nimbus Ledger Sync for UPI reconciliation by November 30, 2026. The meeting established project scope, technical constraints, and a schedule of preparatory tasks including sandbox setup, security reviews, and data mapping. | Decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.; Phase one is strictly limited to UPI reconciliation only, excluding NEFT and IMPS.; Customer-managed encryption keys are not supported; keys are managed by Nimbus in AWS KMS.; Primary data hosting will be in AWS Mumbai with a disaster recovery replica in Singapore. | Tasks: Send the standard mutual NDA to Neha Kapoor (unassigned); Set up the sandbox environment and send API credentials to Vikram's team (unassigned); Give the IP ranges needed allowlisted for the UPI feed (unassigned); Write a mapping document detailing Meridian field to Nimbus field mappings (unassigned); Send the names of two analysts for user acceptance testing (unassigned); Prepare anonymised sample transaction files from the given layout (unassigned); Ensure Meera Iyer's accounts are set up by the end of the day (unassigned)
